final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT k_symbol, AVG(amount) as avg_amount FROM `order` WHERE amount > 2802.0 GROUP BY k_symbol), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as overall_avg FROM step1) SELECT step1.k_symbol, step1.avg_amount, step1.avg_amount - step2.overall_avg as diff FROM step1, step2 WHERE step1.avg_amount > step2.overall_avg
